name: Unichem Laboratories Limited
summary: Unichem Laboratories Limited, a pharmaceutical company, manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in India, the United States, and internationally. The company offers formulation products that address various therapeutic areas, such as gastroenterology, cardiology, diabetology, psychiatry, neurology, anti-bacterial, anti-infective, and pain management. It also offers active pharmaceutical ingredients, as well as contract manufacturing services. In addition, the company manufactures allopathic medicines, bulk drugs, and chemicals. It serves patients, distributors, health care professionals, and government institutions. The company was founded in 1944 and is based in Mumbai, India. Unichem Laboratories Limited is a subsidiary of Ipca Laboratories Limited.
